title: Fuel economy
description:
Read the distance driven in kilometres and the fuel used in litres (both decimals). Print the fuel economy two ways:

```
7.5 L/100km
13.33 km/L
```

(for `400 30`). Litres per 100 km has **one** decimal; kilometres per litre has **two**.
hints: Litres per 100 km is `litres / km * 100`. Kilometres per litre is `km / litres`.
`std::fixed` stays switched on once set. You can change the precision between the two lines with another `std::setprecision`.
